Pixel OS v2.1.0 — Pure Retail Google PixelOS Stable for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Restores 100% Pure Google PixelOS Experience on the default Stable channel: unmodified Retail Google Pixel Launcher (vertical App Drawer + bottom Search bar), stock Material 3 Expressive SystemUI & Notification Shade, stock Android Settings, Google Phone, Google Messages, and circular Pixel adaptive icons
• Quiet, Rock-Solid Stable Channel: regular experimental UI updates are paused on Stable — only verified core hardware, security, and app compatibility fixes are promoted here
• New Opt-In 'iOS Style UI Beta' Toggle in Settings -> System -> System update: turn ON anytime if you want active iOS 26 Liquid Glass UI, Lock Screen, Notification/Control Center, and iOS Dialer/Messages beta updates, or keep OFF for pure Google PixelOS
• Shared Core Fixes Included: Chrome 156+ / WebView zygote_next Linux 4.14 compatibility fix, calibrated OLED low-brightness & HBM boot guard, Pixel 9 GCam 9.6 (all 4 lenses), Unlimited Google Photos backup, and atomic /data/ota_raw block-image OTA support
